balls.text: swung across the line to long-on
sliced over the infield to sweeper cover
muscled over deep midwicket! Nothing ball from Thushara, a helpless hit-me ball slanted on a length outside off, he fetched it and picked the bones out of it. That was bowled at 122kph
goes over cover, looked like he had picked out the sweeper but Wadhera just couldn't hold on as he came rushing in from the boundary. They only take a run because Stubbs was ball-watching
slips this full and way outside off as he tries to bowl a low-slinga. Stubbs lets it go, wide called
sat up nicely for Stubbs as he held his shape and swung across the line to clear long-on
drilled to long-off
squeezes the yorker-length delivery to cover. Just six off the penultimate over.
toe-ends this low full toss to long-off.
punched to deep cover
struck on the pad as Bumrah angles a full ball at 144kph, the ball deflects to the off side and they'll get a bye
backs away and hits this yorker-length delivery to long-off

the loopy bouncer has done the trick! Pant loses control of this attempted pull as the ball gets big on him, he goes through with the top and gets a top-edge that's taken by Rohit who circles around at fine leg.
slips in a full toss down leg as he goes searching for a yorker, Pant misses the tickle. Wide called

Wood bowls another half-tracker that's begging to be pulled and Stubbs says 'thank you' as he sends it flying to the deep midwicket fence. The boundary rider was no more than a couple of metres away but stood no chance
muscled in front of square! Short, sat up nicely and Stubbs displays brute force as he hammers this to bisect deep midwicket and long-on
goes full on the stumps, almost yorker-length on middle, but Stubbs gets nice and low as he reverse scoops this over short third. Absolutely magnificent

this is incredible hand-speed and imagination! Wood goes full outside off, thinking he's defeated the batter in length by not allowing him to get underneath the slog, but Stubbs quickly opens the bat face and reverse ramps him over the third man boundary.

he has shown the ability to hit big previously, now he's showing his ability to ramp and scoop. Gets across the off-stump once again, is nearly falling over when he attempts to paddle it fine but gets enough bat to clear short fine
scooped between keeper and short fine! Wood goes wide yorker, Stubbs still manages to somehow get inside the line before deflecting it up and over
swung across the line, toe-ends the slog to deep midwicket. Superb over from Thushara
pulled in front of square, down to deep midwicket
clubbed down the ground, but Nabi patrols the long-on boundary
forces this short of a length delivery outside off to cover
mistimes this heave to midwicket
timing, placement - all exquisite. Width on offer and Stubbs reached out to pick that low full toss into the gap at deep cover.
genle tab wide of point as Bumrah bowls a slower ball again
hits hard length on middle, Stubbs hops back and defends
right into the blockhole again, dug out. Excellent stop on his followthrough
into the blockhole, ripper of a comeback, Pant somehow preserves his toes while off balance, manages to get some bat on this too
flicked up and over square leg! Bumrah serves up a rare half-volley on the pads and Pant picked him away effortlessly.
hits hard length on middle from wide of the crease, punched down the ground for a single
excellent end to the over for Delhi as Pant gets inside the line and pumps this into the vacant spaces at deep backward square leg.

appeal for lbw as Pant looks to get down on one knee and wallop that over cow corner. Umpire Navdeep Singh Sidhu had a long, hard look but gives it not out. MI opt to review. Hawkeye confirms this googly from Chawla pitched outside leg. Not out it is.
punched to long-on
fired in outside off, cuts and misses.
reverse-swept straight to point
fired full, kept out

just lands short of Wadhera running in from deep midwicket! Stubbs attempts to fetch the slog sweep from way outside off but is deceived in flight, the ball also dipped on him to ensure he didn't get under the length. Lucky break
fired full but way outside off, left alone
pulled to deep midwicket to get off the mark
dug back to the bowler

whips him straight to Tilak coming in from the ropes at deep midwicket. It was timed well, but it was almost as if Hope didn't account for the fielder there. Also the fact that he had to slightly force the pace on this slower length ball made it that much harder. Good, little hand from Hope. Sustained momentum created by JFM. Incredible stuff.
into the blockhole, squeezed to cover where Hardik misfields. A dot ball it should've been but they get two instead
make that two in two! Another attempted short ball that doesn't rise up as much and Hope disdainfully wallops him over cow corner. What muscle.

that has been absolutely pumped over deep midwicket! Hint of premeditation in that stroke, as if he knew Wood would bowl short. This one sat up as it was bowled just under 130 clicks, and Hope bludgeoneds that away.
through with the pull even before the ball arrives, beaten

that's a Pant special! The helicopter is out. Thushara must wonder what he did wrong by bowling length on middle. It's the genius of Pant that's made this pick up shot possible. Strong bottom hands, wrist and power sends it soaring over deep midwicket.
gets the edge as he drives, but doesn't carry to the keeper, they take a single
loses one hand off the bat handle as he tries to open the bat face and punch through point, no pace to work with. They scamper a single to short third.
this one's helped over short fine! Trademark Pant shot. Short and into the body, Pant uses the pace to pick his spot nicely.
struck high on the thigh pad as he tries to work this length ball into the leg side.
clobbered over deep midwicket! This was short and asking to be punished, Hope took full toll of that. Pulled it high and handsome.
steps out and works it through to midwicket
attempts the slog-sweep, goes off a thickish inside edge to deep midwicket
that's hit straight and hit very hard and long! Nabi looks to fire in a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss and Hope swings him straight down the ground.
drifts one into middle and leg, nudged wide of midwicket
squeezes this fired-in full ball to long-on
cut hard to deep point for a single
whips this shortish delivery to deep midwicket
this one's drilled down to Hardik at long-on
slog-swept into the stands! PC tosses this up nicely outside off, throwing the bait to Hope and he took it. Down on one knee as he muscled it away over long-on
whips this down to long-on
drifter across Pant who defends back
tucks it past the bowler to long-on, Pant off the mark
turns it back down the pitch, Nabi hares across to his left to stop the single
beats him in flight and Ishan effects a superb stumping. Porel stepped out to heave this into the leg side but was nowhere near the pitch. Got a thin edge on that as he swung across the line.
milks a single to long-on
whips this down to long-on
whips this down to deep midwicket
slower ball dug into the pitch, Porel is onto his toes as he tries to force it behind point, picks out the fielder.
gets a leading edge back down the pitch, they'll take a single
scorching drive to sweeper cover as Porel jogs a single
looks to take him on with the pull but loses his balance and falls on the floor as he's hit on the body. Porel calls for the physio almost immediately.
deft touch for four! Uses the bowler's pace to slightly arch back and ramp it over short third.
short on off-stump, Porel pulls him in front of square to deep midwicket
pulls to deep midwicket
drifts in a quicker delivery on middle and leg, nudged to square leg
driven straight to cover

a wicket against the run of play and it's Chawla who has delivered. Drifts in a googly, JFM rocks back to pull but is slightly cramped for room, he goes through with the pull and holes out to deep midwicket where Nabi takes a good catch moving a couple of steps back.  JFM was in sight of Gayle's record of a 30-ball hundred, not to be.
pushed through quicker on the stumps, pushed straight to cover
steps out and punches this length ball to long-off
bowls an off-cutter and sees this muscled down the ground for six! Once again JFM backs away to free his arms and swings through like a golfer. Clears long-off quite comfortably.

punched on the up to mid-off, JFM has to use every bit of his reach to try and scamper back into the crease at the striker's end as Nabi fires a throw. Ishan, coming in from his position, tries to cheekily leave the ball anticipating a direct hit but sees this miss the stumps and race away to the boundary behind him. One for the single, four for the overthrow
another poor ball from Hardik and gets punished. This is short and angling down leg, Porel swivels around quickly and uses the pace to pull him wayyyy back over fine leg.  DC's 100 up in the 7th over
wayward from Hardik, a dragdown and Porel gloves this heave to the fine leg boundary
slower length ball outside off, defended back as Porel has no pace to work with.
whips this straight to midwicket
dabbed with soft hands behind the wicket, they scamper a run as the throw comes in from short third.
beaten by the bite off the pitch as Bumrah shortens his length and bowls a cutter into the pitch
defends this as Bumrah hits hard length again
short of length on middle and leg, tucked off his hip past square leg once again
tucks this gently off his hip to square leg
short of a length outside off, Porel gets on top of the bounce and bunts it with soft hands
this is hitting right out of the top drawer! Hardik slips in a length ball on middle and leg, and Fraser-McGurk muscles him deep into the stands over square leg.
Hardik sees him make room and follows him by trying to hit hard length, JFM adjusts incredibly well to still manufacture something as he lofts through the line and comfortably clears mid-off.
quicker bumper from Hardik, beats JFM's attempted pull.
he has clobbered that into downtown Connaught Place! Clears his front leg and simply swings through the line, as if he's on a golf course. Sailed wayyyyyy into the stands over long-on.
spongy bouncer that he tries to fetch from way outside off, mistimes it to midwicket
one bounce into the cover fence! Half-tracker from Hardik to begin with, JFM makes room and wallops that over the infield
eased down to long-on to keep strike once again
punched uppishly down to deep midwicket
flat-bats this down to long-on for a single
short, wide and he transfers weight back to slap that over cover. Incredible
heaved over long-on! What a stunning way to get to a half-century.  Fraser-McGurk equals his own record for his fastest IPL fifty - off 15 balls.
tucks it down to long-on as they jog the single
beats him with an excellent slower delivery into the pitch, JFM was through with the pull even before the ball arrived.
brute force! Thushara must be thanking his stars this didn't hit his shin on his followthrough. JFM hits this dead straight and hard. Phew, no chance for the bowler. Raced away
full toss that he flicks between his legs and beats short-fine. Thushara went yorker-length but missed his mark by a long way. Went for a yorker with fine leg up, not a good idea.
slips in a high full toss down leg, JFM looks to lend direction to it but misses, wide called.
backs away and carves this full delivery over the covers! Didn't time it as well as he would've liked but got enough on it.
chips it down to long-on for a single
Porel joins the party! Starts with a nice lovely half-volley on off-stump and he belts him down the ground to beat mid-off.

no respect for reputation or seniority. He's here to stamp his authority from get go. Stunning from Jake Fraser-McGurk. Picks length early and wallops this pull in front of square to the midwicket fence.
punches this short-of-length delivery to mid-on for a quick single
slips this down leg as he attempts a slower delivery, Porel misses the tickle. Wide called as Ishan collects on the bounce
hits hard lengths on middle from around the stumps, tucked to midwicket
bowls an off-cutter just outside off, carefully defended
right into the blockhole this time, nudged into the leg side for a single.
goes yorker-length but misses it by a fraction and Fraser-McGurk drills him down the ground to beat mid-on. We're just about an over into the game but have already seen some audacious hitting.
greets Bumrah with a six over long-on! He goes slower and fuller, JFM picks the length early and muscles him over the ropes. What's worse for MI? This is a no-ball, so a free-hit is coming up.
tucks it to square leg for a single, Capitals with a bombastic start already.
he has absolutely slapped that disdainfully through cover! Short of length and angling across, JFM stays besides the line and uses the hint of width to bludgeon that.
was readying himself to short-arm jab that through midwicket but ended up simply defending it to the fielder in the end
whips this over long-on! All wrist and forearm strength. Wood goes length on middle and leg, JFM picks him up and over. Sailed wayyyyy over. Incredible start.
belted down the ground for four! Wood shortens his length a touch and lands it on middle, JFM swings through the line as he goes downtown. Lovely hitting. Zero fear.
pitched-up on the pads, there's a hint of inswing but JFM flicks him superbly into the gap between midwicket and mid-on! Sublime timing.
full toss, plops into the hands of mid-on, and that's a wrap! A valiant chase but Mukesh and Dar close out a ten-run win
Chawla finds the boundary, but it's too late Full length, hacked with an open face over the covers... it's another 500-run game!
in the slot, but he scuffs his swing this time, and knows it too. A inside-edged drag to the on-side, and barring extras, this one's in the bag
Wood with the wallop, high over deep midwicket! It's not done yet you know... back of a length and bashed with disdain over the ropes!
knuckle-ball, heaved in the air, McGurk rushes in at deep midwicket and drops a sprawling effort! No boundary though...

slower ball, hoisted high in the air!  Lands short of square leg, but Varma's sprawl for the second run looks to be short! Indeed, he's been given on-field as well. A valiant knock, but that, surely, is the game!

Powerful timing on the drive into the covers!  But Dar is rewarded for his commitment to the yorker as the cover sweeper dives round to cut off the boundary. They make it back for three but a 16-run over leaves a big ask now
outside off, and that's a good retort! Full, fast, too wide to lay a bat on it. But they rush the bye to the keeper
thumped straight into the sightscreen! Wild striking from Chawla! Deep in his crease, mitigating the yorker length, and gets right under his massive flat blow!
goes for broke again, but Hope is on the ropes! Good contact to get the crowd excited but long-on was right back on the fence to end the assault. A dot-ball almost as precious as the wicket
that makes up for the dot! Back of the hand, but Nabi just swung for the hills, through the line and high over long-off!
full outside off, close to the tramlines, but there's a review...the batter hadn't moved across his stumps, but the on-field call was fine. Priceless dot

full toss, panned over backward square! That's some startling timing, kneeling outside off, and sweeping on the full, dead-eyed contact, high into the stands! Priceless boundary to stay up with the rate.
bottom-handed bash, into the on-side

Pant comes up to the stumps. Interesting... nailed on the pads! The review has been taken but this looks plumb! The keeper ruse prevented David from using his feet with the same freedom, but it took a dead-eyed delivery to capitalise. Full, straight, attacking the stumps, he had walked across to the off-side once more, but was struck in line on umpire's call, and the rest was plumb!
full toss, too straight, boshed over long-on! Mukesh is right under the cosh now... 16 off the over, three balls to come... an eye-in swing through the line as David comes to the party
stepping across to off once more, and dragged through midwicket! Looking for the six, but four will do, just a touch inside-half of the bat, but into the gap!
kill or be killed! David steps across his crease, accessing the leg-side with a violent pick-up across the pads! High over long-on!
another yorker, squirts off a leading edge out to the covers. Wonderful over, just seven from it, and now MI need a monster over just to stay in touch
drilled down to long-on, but another excellent blockhole ball, angled in at a yorker length from round the wicket
pace off, back of a length, wiped across the line but square leg is well placed back on the fence
blockhole ball, that's a lovely line, whistling in at the left-hander, who can't do much with that, but a single to the on-side
attempted scoop, stepping to the off-side, Dar reacts by firing in a full-toss outside off, and beats Tilak's intentions
full length, tight to the pads, clipped to mid-on for the single
bouncer, but too short for the square-leg umpire's liking
too full and wide, swinging away outside off
wider on the crease, angled into the stumps, clipped to the on-side... 13 off the over to keep in touch
drilled mightily through the covers! Touch of width and walloped!
full length, good blockhole ball, a big swing for no great impact, to backward square
hoisted to the on-side, loses his shape on the full length outside off, long-on gathers
fired down the leg side, can't connect, no need to connect
short, into the body, Tilak shimmies inside the line and cuffs it away, off the glove rather than bat maybe, but to the rope either way.... still brawling
full length, draws a languid slam through the line, on the bounce to the boundary-rider at long-on
hoisted down the ground for a 21-run over! The patient has a pulse! Kuldeep serves up another slottable offering, and gets dumped back over his head!
premeditated reverse sweep, and powered through backward point! Kuldeep is having an off-day and MI are capitalising!
another drag-down from Kuldeep and this is a firmer strike, flat into the gap at wide long-on. Good slide from Stubbs but he can't cut it off
back of a length, pushed to the off side
Not convincing but into the gap! Too short from Kuldeep, Tilak hoists it leg-side, and finds enough of a gap despite not timing his stroke
looped onto a leg-stump line, tapped off the back foot to backward square
back of a length, crunched across the line but straight to the sweeper. 11 off the over, good by ordinary standards, but the rate keeps rising
huge! David lines up the wide line, steps back and across and muscles a full-blooded swing high over midwicket!
back of a length, Tilak hops back to cut out to deep cover
steps into the wide line, loses his shape as the ball skews down to deep third on the bounce
bottom-handed bash, no power through the stroke as mid-on gathers
tries to reverse the stance, can't get it away as the bowler follows him outside off
tapped to the off-side, the end of a magnificent over from Dar. What an impact from the sub!

genuine nick outside off, tumbling take by Pant! It's like watching Test cricket, welcome back old friend! Outside off, angle nipping back into the left-hander, who shaped to run the ball down to deep third but was conventionally beaten off the pitch. The die is cast
fires in the yorker, but that's down the leg-side, helped on its way through fine leg

straight up in the air and now DC are closing in! Hardik had another hack through the full length outside off, but he wasn't close enough to the pitch and Mukesh at point had oodles of time to steady himself
round the wicket, chiselled off the pads to the on-side
fires in the yorker, nearly prises the wicket! Dug out on the full, right at the toe of the bat, and plugs safely between the fielders at mid-on
fuller length, clubbed hard to long-on. A 14-run over is just about par for the chase.
outside off, full toss, lures an open-faced slap and cuffed away through deep third. Needs some more of those, but Hardik is keeping his team in touch
low full toss, flicked off the toes to the on-side
leans through the full length and punched down the ground to long-off
blatted off the hard length, high over midwicket! Solid base from Hardik, and baseball-ed into the stands!
tight lines from over the wicket, into the left-hander's pads. Goes for the big wind-up but can't connect
yes he can! Full and fast, beats a wafty drive on the full toss, through to the keeper. Five runs off the over at this stage is a golden effort from the impact sub
outside off, back of a length, flat-batted to deep point, this is a very good over so far... can he close it out?
another good yorker, well dug out to the on-side
now then, a review for caught behind... didn't seem to be a lot in it to the naked eye. A flat-footed wipe through the wide line outside off... yep, daylight
round the wicket, that's an excellent yorker, angled in at the base of middle and off, pressed to cover
cuffed with an open face, down to deep third
short and wide, loops over the batter who doesn't shape for a shot
Reverse-sweep, nailed through deep third! Back to back boundaries keep MI in touch with their rate
dragged down, dragged over long-on! Picked up from outside off, as Tilak gets underneath his launch, over the head of the leaping Hope!
round the wicket, speared in at the pads, and tucked to the on-side
half an appeal as Axar targets the stumps
cut out to deep point
flicked out to deep midwicket
Here comes Hardik! The hundred is up with a fast, flat, brutal six through long-on, to end a leaky over from Kuldeep! Leaning onto the back foot to muscle that over the ropes
better line and length as Kuldeep drags the right-hander forward
rocks back for a slammed cut/drive through the covers! Sprawling effort on the rope so nearly saves four
over-pitched outside leg and cuffed hard through backward square on the sweep. Good impetus from the skipper
just short of Williams at deep square leg! He didn't pick it up in time, and was yorked by the awkward bounce as he dived forward
cut away to the point sweeper
sweet strike, clean down the ground! Over-pitched as Axar takes the pace off the ball, and gets deposited back over his head
held back in the flight, Tilak waits on the back foot to punch to deep cover
firm stride to the good length from round the wicket, just singles on offer for now, to mid-off this time
over the wicket now to the left-hander, clipped off the pads
dragged to the leg side, hard to line up the angle from round the wicket
cuffed off the front foot into the covers
just a diet of singles as long-off intercepts a firm punch down the ground. Tidy
stops in the pitch, on the pads, tapped square for another single. Mumbai need more than that to stay in touch
big turn but too wide on the initial line
thumped firmly across the line but deep midwicket is set back to defend the rope
back of a length, cuffed on the up out to the covers
tidy length, over the wicket again, pressed off the front foot into the off side
over the wicket, worked off the legs

jabbed to cover and the SKY has fallen in! Pace off from round the wicket, sticks in the pitch, Suryakumar Yadav's hard hands were committed to the back-foot drive, and it was a simple popped chance to Williams to end the powerplay on a high for DC!
round the wicket, full length on a very wide line, SKY chooses to chase it and why not... a thin edge through the gap between keeper and short third
fenced into the off side

yawned over backward square! How does he create those angles? Pace off the ball, outside off, he climbed through the pull and somehow inverted his wrists to delay the impact and help it over the ropes!
clubbed firmly off the back foot, but sharp fielding in the covers cuts off the run
on the back foot, guided down to deep third
Width outside off! Same result, slapped uppishly through backward point as those final two balls dent an otherwise fine over
helped off the hips! Wrong line this time from Mukesh, back of a length with pace off the ball,  and whipped through fine leg to bring up the fifty
back of a length, wider line, but a flowing slapped drive finds cover. Dots galore
yorker, excellent execution, right in at the toes, and dug out back to the bowler
hard length from Mukesh, across the left-hander, pressed into the off-siue

fired into the good length but took the pace off! Ishan goes for the slap through the line but can't time it on impact. The bat turns in his hands as Axar swoops round to gather at wide mid-off. Big breakthrough!
full length into the toes, worked off the pads to square leg
change of pace, back of a length, beats another whoosh to leg
gets enough on a launch over the covers, off the toe of the bat
helicoptered off the good length! That's how SKY rolls, stepping to off and slamming his wrists across the line!
greeted with a good-length cutter, patted back down the line to mid-off
Rohit falls! Hope in the covers cleans up an attempt to clear mid-off, scuffed off a leading edge. Not a particularly successful day out, as Hope leaps to his left to gather
low full toss, angled into the pads, Rohit drives with an open face and that's a good intercept in the covers
short and sharp again, Ishan rolls into a defensive pull to square leg
Dropped, but harsh to judge it as such! Flogged off the full length, such power through the stroke! Lizaad sticks out his right hand and can't cling on, but he does save four!
low full-toss, arrow straight, fenced to the on-side as one hand comes off the blade again
attacking full length, hint of shape back into the bat, chopped down into the crease
hoisted through midwicket! One hand comes off the bat, but it matters not. Pace off, chunked off the splice of the bat, but into a yawning gap in front of square
fuller length, met under the eyes with a push to the on-side, for a single to keep the strike. The chase is on
bludgeoned! In the slot, outside off, stand-and-deliver tonkage from Ishan, clean through long-on!
genuine edge but Pant is flat-footed! Had a wave through the length and gets away with it
steps into the full length, angled into the pads, and wonderful whippy wrists through midwicket!
full length, pushed across Rohit, who slashes with an open face to deep point
over the wicket with his left-arm action, angled into the left-hander, fended off the hip

Closes the face on the full length, pumped on the up through the on-side. An excellent debut over, but it still goes for 12. That's the IPL for you... EDIT: 14 off the over, as a belated review shows that the fielder Khaleel touched the rope

swings away down the leg-side! But fortunately for Lizaad, there was a feather of bat on that pull, as the keeper wasn't cutting it off... but Rohit is reviewing the decision... and yep, no bat involved! Extra ball coming up
free hit... and a beauty... inswinging yorker, no contact on the flash across the line
gives it the gallop but beaten for pace again, Williams follows Rohit with a hard length into the pitch, and it's spliced to the on-side... but a no-ball ruins the overall effect!
good pace again, this over is already significantly less productive than DC's first of the powerplay...
hurried on the bouncer! Rohit knows nothing about that as the ball swings back at the batter, as he flings his bat in front of his helmet and accepts the top-edge over the keeper. Wheels!
fired past the pads, decent carry at 147.9kph but off-line
shape on a good length, back into the left-hander, punched to the on-side
on the money this time, good pitch-hitting length, across the left-hander, who defends
